selectionFlow.switchActiveKind: Reset every component state of the chosen cache to On; OFF disables selection without rewriting component states.
selectionFlow.detailConfirm: Save draft first; parent collects supported master change flags. If no supported component remains On, select OFF; otherwise notify preview.
selectionFlow.list: UserLimitedSkinInventory entries map to MasterLimitedSkin, never MasterCollaborationSkin. Selected ID is persisted on confirm; wait for pending SpotAssetManager loads, invoke parent callback, then close. Parent resets Limited states to On even for the same ID. Back closes without confirming.

listLayout.columns: truncate(panelWidth / cellWidth); constructor arguments 1 and 3 are buffer rows, NOT columns
listLayout.cellPosition: offsetLeft + column*217, -(offsetTop + row*170); content transform is (-panelWidth/2, panelHeight/2)
listLayout.contentSize: width = columns*217 + offsetLeft + offsetRight; height = rows*170 + offsetTop + offsetBottom
listLayout.offsets: Serialized scrollContentOffset=(0,0), split in half to each axis edge
listLayout.initialSelection: Selected and equipped indices identify the cache entry; they do not set scroll position. OnStartCreateContent calls SelectEquipScrollController.SetScrollPosition(0).
listLayout.selection: Click changes pending selection, keeps equipped entry until confirmation; cancel leaves parent cache unchanged.
listLayout.scope: Application list positioning, content dimensions and initial selection. Native host scroll physics and Unity recycling buffers are not emulated.
